These are release specifications, not evidence that every workflow becomes cheaper.","zh":"腾讯于7月6日正式发布Hy3。官方公告给出的核心规格是混合快慢思考、MoE架构、295B总参数、21B激活参数，以及最高256K上下文；同时宣布采用Apache 2.0许可，并接入旗下多款产品。这些是发布规格，不能直接推导出所有业务的成本都会下降。"},{"en":"The accompanying model card emphasizes tool-call stability, recovery from errors, and retaining user constraints across multiple turns. That focus matters: a useful agent must preserve the original goal after inspecting files, calling tools, and encountering failures. This can reduce arithmetic relative to a dense model of the same total size. It does not remove the inactive experts from storage. Deployment still needs a strategy for keeping, distributing, or moving those weights, and routing introduces communication work.","zh":"稀疏MoE让每个token只经过部分专家，因此相对于同等总参数规模的稠密模型，计算量可能更低。但没有被当前token选中的专家依然需要存储；部署系统仍要决定这些权重放在哪里、如何分片，以及是否需要搬运。专家路由也会带来通信开销。"},{"en":"As a rough engineering estimate, 295B parameters at two bytes per parameter require about 590 GB for weights alone. This decimal estimate excludes caches, activations, runtime buffers, and implementation details. Quantization changes the weight term; longer prompts and more concurrent sessions change the rest. Capacity planning should therefore start with a memory budget, not an active-parameter headline.","zh":"做一个粗略的工程估算：若295B参数按每参数2字节存储，仅权重约需590GB（十进制）。这个估算不包含KV缓存、激活、运行时缓冲，也没有展开具体实现。量化改变的是权重这一项，长提示词和更多并发会增加其他部分。因此容量规划应从完整内存账本开始，而不是只看激活参数。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Evaluate completed work rather than isolated calls","zh":"评测重点：完成一次工作到底要付出多少"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"For a coding workflow, I would compare models on the same repository snapshots, tool schemas, network rules, and hidden acceptance tests. Record tool errors, retries, input and output tokens, elapsed time, and whether the final patch actually passes. A model that uses fewer tokens per call can still be expensive if it repeatedly loses context.","zh":"对代码任务，我会固定仓库快照、工具定义、网络规则和隐藏验收测试，再比较模型。除了最终是否通过，还应记录工具错误、重试次数、输入输出token和总耗时。每次调用更省token的模型，如果反复丢失上下文，完成整项工作仍可能更贵。"},{"en":"A useful metric is total operating cost divided by accepted tasks, counting failed runs in the numerator. Pair it with a latency distribution and a manual audit of a sample of accepted outputs. This makes serving efficiency and reliability visible in the same decision, without assuming the vendor's benchmark mix matches a private workload.","zh":"一个实用指标是：总运行成本除以验收通过的任务数，并把失败运行的成本计入分子。再配合延迟分布和通过样本的人工抽查，才能把推理效率与可靠性放进同一个决策中，而不是默认厂商的评测任务恰好代表自己的业务。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Deployment takeaway","zh":"部署判断"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Hy3 is worth evaluating as an open deployment option, especially when control over weights and tool integration matters.
